run_python_code_in_isolated_process: run a Python code snippet in an isolated subprocess with timeout and capture stdout stderr output
execute_code_with_session_reset: execute Python code by resetting the interpreter session and returning an ExecutionResult with terminal output
cleanup_python_interpreter_process: terminate the child Python process with escalation from terminate to kill to SIGKILL
generate_exception_summary_with_tracebac: generate a formatted exception summary with stack trace using IPython or standard traceback formatting
redirect_stdout_to_multiprocessing_queue: redirect stdout and stderr to a multiprocessing Queue using the RedirectQueue file-like object
